systems.owner: Irembo, a private company in which the government holds a stake, under a 25-year agreement
systems.tiers: online single-window platform with 4,000 agents; parents download a birth certificate within hours of a hospital registering the birth online

note: An interview on the Irembo portal: its chief executive says in passing that a hospital registers a birth online, naming no registration system; the system described is the certificate channel.
